boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten distinct Moon Campus places with documented student-facing uses, from a multipurpose gathering room to recreation, study, support, and campus-life spaces.

cards.title: Olsen Family Basement
cards.subtitle: Nicholson Center • student gathering space
cards.notes: Bring a group for the pool and ping-pong tables, TVs, and stage; the space also includes commuter amenities and a conference room.
cards.short_summary: A documented multipurpose room for hanging out, games, and small-group time.
cards.evidence_claim: RMU describes the Olsen Family Basement in Nicholson Center as a central student gathering place with furniture, TVs, pool and ping-pong tables, a stage, commuter amenities, and a conference room.
cards.source_title: Robert Morris University Announces New Named Spaces on Campus
cards.access_notes: Located inside Nicholson Center; check building access and event use before visiting.

cards.title: Gazebo
cards.subtitle: 316 Massey Way • Moon Campus
cards.notes: Use this named outdoor gathering spot for a meet-up or a quiet pause between classes; keep plans flexible around weather and scheduled activity.
cards.short_summary: A small, named student gathering space on Massey Way.
cards.evidence_claim: RMU lists the Gazebo at 316 Massey Way on Moon Campus with the primary use “Student Gathering Space.”
cards.access_notes: Outdoor space on Moon Campus; weather and campus programming may affect use.

cards.title: Jefferson Center
cards.subtitle: 346 Massey Way • services, fitness, and computers
cards.notes: Head here when you need the documented fitness center, Veterans Lounge, Student Health Services, or the 24/7 computer lab in one building.
cards.short_summary: One campus building that combines practical student services with fitness and computing.
cards.evidence_claim: RMU lists Jefferson Center’s primary uses as Student Health Services, Fitness Center, Vets Lounge, Phonathon, and a 24/7 Computer Lab.
cards.access_notes: Services and building access can have separate eligibility and operating requirements.

cards.title: RMU Nature Trail
cards.subtitle: Behind Jefferson Center and Colonial Village
cards.notes: Take the documented mile-long loop for a daytime walk; it begins behind Jefferson Center and returns behind Colonial Village.
cards.short_summary: A named one-mile campus loop for a low-key outdoor break.
cards.evidence_claim: RMU states that its mile-long Nature Trail starts behind Jefferson Center and loops back around behind Colonial Village.
cards.access_notes: Use appropriate daylight and weather judgment; trail conditions are not stated on the source.

cards.title: Student Recreation and Fitness Center
cards.subtitle: North Athletic Complex • recreation programming
cards.notes: Check the recreation schedule, complete any required waiver, and choose from the documented indoor club, intramural, group-exercise, and wellness activity options.
cards.short_summary: The campus recreation hub for organized sports, fitness, and wellness programming.
cards.evidence_claim: RMU says its Student Recreation and Fitness Center houses indoor club sports, intramural sports, group exercise, and physical wellness programming.
cards.access_notes: Membership, waiver, and facility rules apply; check the current recreation page before arrival.

cards.title: Gus Krop Gym
cards.subtitle: John Jay Center • indoor intramurals
cards.notes: Look for intramural or club-sport activity in this gym; it can be arranged as a main basketball or volleyball court or smaller basketball courts.
cards.short_summary: A current-student gym for indoor intramurals and club-sport practices.
cards.evidence_claim: RMU states that Gus Krop Gym in John Jay Center houses indoor intramural activities and is used by club sports teams for weekly practices.
cards.access_notes: RMU says the gym is only for current RMU students; follow posted scheduling and facility rules.

cards.title: Patrick Henry Center
cards.subtitle: 310 Massey Way • library and academic support
cards.notes: Use the library facilities when you need a study-oriented stop, then pair it with a Career Center or Honors Lounge appointment if relevant.
cards.short_summary: A campus academic building that combines library resources with student-success offices.
cards.evidence_claim: RMU lists Patrick Henry Center’s primary uses as Library, Career Center, Honors Lounge, and Academic Affairs.
cards.access_notes: Library and office access may vary by service and academic calendar.

cards.title: Massey Hall
cards.subtitle: 372 Massey Way • performing arts and theatre
cards.notes: Watch for performances or program activity connected to this performing-arts and theatre building; confirm event details before making a special trip.
cards.short_summary: A named campus destination associated with performing arts and theatre.
cards.evidence_claim: RMU lists Massey Hall’s primary uses as Performing Arts, Theatre, and School of Business faculty offices.
cards.access_notes: Performance and event access depend on the particular program or reservation.

cards.title: Melvin D. Teetz House
cards.subtitle: 359 Massey Way • Center for Global Engagement
cards.notes: Make this your starting point for questions about global-engagement opportunities, and contact the center before visiting for program-specific guidance.
cards.short_summary: The named home of RMU’s Center for Global Engagement.
cards.evidence_claim: RMU lists Melvin D. Teetz House at 359 Massey Way on Moon Campus with the primary use “Center for Global Engagement.”
cards.access_notes: Office services and availability may be appointment- or calendar-dependent.

cards.title: Rogal Family Chapel
cards.subtitle: 419 Pennsylvania Avenue • Campus Ministry
cards.notes: Check Campus Ministry programming if you want to visit this dedicated chapel space, and observe any service or reservation guidance when you arrive.
cards.short_summary: A named campus chapel associated with Campus Ministry.
cards.evidence_claim: RMU lists Rogal Family Chapel at 419 Pennsylvania Avenue on Moon Campus with the primary use “Campus Ministry.”
cards.access_notes: Access and worship-program details may vary; consult Campus Ministry before visiting.
